name: region
title: Board region
description: The frame of one area of the board: its title, how many of its items are decided, the layout-mode buttons and Reset places, drawn as one generic element whatever the mode. Cards and wires are drawn in their own layers (D-013), so the element is only the frame.

files.template: region-template.ts (regionTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.styles: region.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only)

attributes.data-mode: grid | flow | lanes | radial | list: the layout in force (set by update)
attributes.aria-labelledby: region-<id>, the heading inside the frame (set by render)

methods.render(r: Region): once per view version: data-region, role, aria-labelledby, innerHTML = regionTemplate(r)
methods.update(st: RegionState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-mode, mode button aria-pressed, count text, Reset places and the empty message shown or hidden), so focus survives

events: button[data-mode] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the mode action
button[data-reset] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin every node of the region
whenToUse: The frame of every area of the board that has its own layout mode.
whenNotToUse: Lane bands and labels inside a region (the wires layer draws them until <vb-link> arrives); cards (<vb-node>).
accessibility: A labelled region landmark named by its heading. The mode buttons are real buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed; Reset places is a real button, hidden when there is nothing to reset.
